headline: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions releases investor presentation
hook: New operational insights from Inventurus Knowledge
summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has filed its latest investor presentation with the NSE. The document provides updated details on the company's business operations and financial performance. Retail investors can review these materials to better understand the company's current strategic direction and growth metrics.
why_it_matters: Provides transparency on company performance for existing and potential shareholders.

headline: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions releases September quarter financial results
summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has officially filed its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026. The submission was made to the NSE as part of the company's mandatory regulatory disclosure requirements. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal to assess the company's operational performance.
why_it_matters: Review earnings to gauge company growth and valuation trends.

headline: Centrum releases Diwali stock picks for Samvat 2083 with up to 32% projected upside
hook: Brokerage picks five stocks for Samvat 2083
summary: Centrum Finverse Research has released its Diwali stock recommendations for Samvat 2083, naming HFCL, Greaves Cotton, Manorama Industries, Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, and Varun Beverages as top picks. The brokerage projects a potential upside ranging from 20% to 32% for these counters based on anticipated growth prospects. Indian retail investors tracking festive season trading strategies can evaluate these recommendations against their individual portfolio risk profiles.
why_it_matters: Festive stock picks offer retail investors new ideas for portfolio review
winners_losers: Centrum recommended stocks gain attention / unrated peers neutral
